Other notes feature upcoming independent wrestling appearances, TNA programming updates, and media announcements from across the professional wrestling landscape.

stories.title: Motor City Machine Guns Set for House of Glory Return in Chicago
stories.tldr: The Motor City Machine Guns are scheduled to make their return to House of Glory at the upcoming Windy City Warfare event. Chris Sabin and Alex Shelley will appear at the Logan Square Auditorium in Chicago on Friday, September 25, though their opponents have not yet been named by the promotion. The show will be broadcast live and free of charge on YouTube starting at 8 p.m. Central Time. This appearance comes on the heels of Sabin and Shelley joining All Elite Wrestling earlier this summer, where they officially debuted on the July 30 episode of Collision.

stories.title: MR. TITO:  WWE and TKO Should Seriously Consider MOVING WrestleMania 43 Away from Saudi Arabia Due to Safety Concerns
stories.tldr: Wrestling columnist Mr. Tito argues that WWE and TKO should seriously reconsider hosting WrestleMania 43 in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, due to escalating geopolitical and physical safety risks. While the multi-million dollar partnership has been highly lucrative since 2018, it has historically involved controversies including human rights issues, political pressure, and a 2019 travel stranded incident. Furthermore, recent military conflicts involving Iran, Israel, the United States, and Houthi drone and missile attacks near Riyadh create a volatile environment. The promotion must weigh massive financial payouts against the very real dangers posed to wrestlers, production crews, and fans attending the event.

stories.title: Nyla Rose hints that it’s not Tony Khan who’s to blame for her absence from AEW
stories.tldr: Former AEW Women's World Champion Nyla Rose has been absent from AEW television and Ring of Honor throughout 2024 despite staying busy on the independent scene internationally. During recent interview appearances, Rose addressed her frustrating absence and the Oklahoma State Athletic Commission warning following her match there. When a podcast host joked about confronting AEW head Tony Khan, Rose defended him by stating she genuinely does not believe he is to blame. This hints that someone with even greater authority, or external corporate pressures, may be the reason she remains off television.

stories.title: Fizzling WWE Deal a net positive for TNA
stories.tldr: The partnership between WWE and TNA appears to have failed in its rumored primary objective to severely undercut AEW's viewership and momentum. Despite clear creative imbalances where NXT talent frequently won TNA gold without much reciprocity, the deal ultimately served as a net positive by granting TNA mainstream exposure and paving the way to WWE opportunities for stars like Jordynne Grace and Mike Santana. Although recent programming shows a total halt in talent crossovers, the agreement reportedly runs through 2028 and includes a right of first refusal for WWE regarding any potential TNA sale.

stories.title: Rob Van Dam Addresses Potential Run With Major Promotion
stories.tldr: WWE Hall of Famer Rob Van Dam recently discussed his wrestling future on his podcast, revealing that he does not expect another extended run with a major promotion. After spending nearly a year sidelined with broken heels, the veteran returned to action earlier this year and anticipates wrestling a few more matches before the end of 2026. While he is not actively planning for a major contract or chasing championships, RVD remains open to whatever sporadic opportunities might come his way.

stories.title: Second generation stars to join WWE faction (and one is signed in another company)
stories.tldr: The NXT faction BirthRight, built around legendary multi-generational heritage, could soon expand its ranks with new second-generation talent. Potential additions include newly signed WWE developmental talent Aalyah Gutierrez, independent veteran Brock Anderson, and TNA-signed Avery Styles. Former NXT general manager Ava also represents a unique fourth-generation possibility, despite currently working outside the industry. While drawing comparisons to the main roster Bloodline, these rising stars could eventually make a major impact on Raw or SmackDown if given the opportunity.

stories.title: Nyla Rose on her absence from AEW television: “There may be some things I can’t talk about”
stories.tldr: Former AEW Women’s Champion Nyla Rose has addressed her ongoing absence from television since late 2024 in recent interviews with Jasmin St. Claire and Denise Salcedo. While making it clear that she does not blame AEW President Tony Khan for her lack of TV time, she admitted that the situation is frustrating because she wants to achieve more in her career. Rose also hinted that there are certain details regarding her situation that she cannot openly discuss.

stories.title: RVD Gives Update On Wrestling Future, Potential Run With Major Promotion
stories.tldr: WWE Hall of Famer Rob Van Dam recently provided an update on his wrestling career, noting that he expects to wrestle three or four matches before the end of the year. RVD is currently taking a part-time approach following a lengthy recovery from breaking both heels at MLW Battle Riot VII. While he is not actively expecting another full-time run or major championship opportunity with a prominent promotion, he is keeping an open mind about future possibilities. Van Dam previously made several sporadic appearances for All Elite Wrestling, but his current focus remains on living in the present rather than chasing new career goals.

stories.title: Club WWE won’t work with random old WWE programming and skippable PLE shows | Column
stories.tldr: Club WWE has generated significant discussion recently after adding high-profile content like the Stephanie Vaquer versus Liv Morgan house show title change and select classic episodes of Raw. However, relying on random uploads of older programming and scattered live events will likely fall short of sustaining a paid subscription service. While WWE is attempting to emulate the fan monetisation strategies of English football clubs, pro wrestling fandom operates differently than traditional generational sports loyalty. Without a comprehensive catalog or a focus on the storyline progression fans actively seek, this platform model faces distinct challenges in driving long-term subscriptions.

stories.title: Yota Tsuji Wants To Equalize Relationship Between NJPW & AEW
stories.tldr: Current IWGP Heavyweight Champion Yota Tsuji previously voiced frustration over the one-sided partnership between New Japan Pro Wrestling and AEW, even attempting to lead a boycott of the Forbidden Door event. However, Tsuji's stance has recently softened as he now aims to establish a genuinely equal working relationship between the two promotions. During a press conference for the upcoming Destruction in Kobe event, he emphasized his goal to level the playing field while expanding pro wrestling's reach across Asia. Meanwhile, the upcoming Kobe card will still feature prominent AEW talent representation through matches involving Claudio Castagnoli and Gabe Kidd.

stories.title: Janel Grant says she feels “forgiveness” towards former WWE owner Vince McMahon
stories.tldr: Janel Grant, the former WWE employee who filed a federal lawsuit against Vince McMahon and the company in January 2024 accusing him of sex trafficking, recently spoke about her current mindset in a comprehensive interview. She revealed that she feels a sense of forgiveness and even empathy toward McMahon, explaining that the traumatic events have paradoxically impacted them both. Rather than focusing solely on the past abuse, her mind is occupied by the complex web of decision-makers and the series of events that ultimately brought the scandal to light. Grant described the surreal experience of becoming the center of the massive controversy as watching her life turn into a movie happening around her.

stories.title: AEW’s Death Riders add new member
stories.tldr: Jon Moxley's Death Riders faction in AEW has officially filled the vacancy left by Will Ospreay by recruiting CMLL micro luchador Kemalito. The surprising addition was revealed when Kemalito appeared wearing a Death Riders patch on his gear, a symbol carrying significant weight in the ongoing storyline. Although Kemalito unfortunately lost his recent match against Kemonito at Arena Mexico, fans have already embraced the crossover by creating custom introductory video packages. This unique alliance stems from the ongoing talent exchanges between the promotion and CMLL, opening up surreal and exciting possibilities for the micro star's future involvement in AEW.

stories.title: Jim Ross Doesn’t Like WWE’s Recent Moves Against AEW: “Because I Know The Motivation …”
stories.tldr: AEW commentator and WWE Hall of Famer Jim Ross recently criticized WWE for scheduling a Worlds Collide event in the Chicago area on the exact same weekend as AEW All Out. Ross argued that the scheduling was driven by competitive motivation rather than a pure desire to entertain fans. He expressed frustration that the wrestling industry continues to operate with a counterproductive mindset instead of focusing on mutual growth. Ultimately, Ross believes there were simply too many coincidences surrounding the event for WWE's timing to be innocent.

stories.title: Rob Van Dam gives update on his wrestling future
stories.tldr: Wrestling veteran Rob Van Dam recently provided an update on his in-ring future, estimating that he will likely wrestle only three or four matches before the end of 2026. This cautious schedule comes after RVD spent nearly a year out of action due to breaking both of his heels at an MLW event, though he has since returned for matches in Australia and for Juggalo Championship Wrestling. During his podcast, he noted that he is not expecting any major runs or offers from major wrestling companies, preferring to live in the present rather than chasing specific goals.

stories.title: Backstage News On Wrestling Company’s Paramount+ Talks Falling Apart
stories.tldr: A prominent wrestling promotion was reportedly in advanced negotiations with Paramount+ a little over a year ago to secure a streaming deal, but the talks ultimately fell apart. According to Dave Meltzer, the promotion felt confident because Paramount+ lacked wrestling content at the time, but the situation collapsed due to executive changes during the Skydance merger and Paramount ultimately landing a deal with the UFC. Meanwhile, the recent corporate landscape shifts have sparked speculation regarding AEW's future, particularly given existing connections between Tony Khan and Paramount CEO David Ellison.

stories.title: WWE Worlds Collide interest dropping because of live stream confusion? | Column
stories.tldr: Google Search interest for the upcoming WWE Worlds Collide event in Rosemont, Illinois, is currently tracking lower than it was during the promotion's 2025 peak. The drop in online hype is primarily driven by widespread confusion and a baffling lack of clarity regarding whether the show will actually be broadcast via a live stream. Despite strong live ticket sales exceeding 10k, the absence of a confirmed viewing option has raised major questions about the strategic purpose of the event.

stories.title: WWE Shop pulls Trick Williams “Lemon Pepper Steppers” t-shirt after receiving fan backlash
stories.tldr: WWE quickly pulled a new Trick Williams Lemon Pepper Steppers t-shirt from WWEShop.com just 24 hours after its September 21, 2026 release. The design featured Williams' signature white boot surrounded by fried chicken wings, which immediately sparked intense fan backlash on social media over racial stereotypes. Critics quickly drew comparisons to WWE's infamous 2019 Jordan Myles and ACH merchandise controversy. Despite the swift removal and the official product description leaning into his catchphrases and two-stepping persona, the misstep raised serious questions about how the design was approved in the first place.

stories.title: What the Warner Brothers Discovery/Paramount merger could possibly mean for AEW’s future
stories.tldr: A potential media merger between Warner Brothers Discovery and Paramount could significantly impact All Elite Wrestling's broadcasting future, though the ultimate outcome remains completely unpredictable. While AEW President Tony Khan is reportedly confident and has engaged with Paramount leadership regarding potential streaming and broadcast opportunities, industry observers note several potential hurdles. These challenges include possible international broadcast conflicts, competing industry relationships, and general corporate uncertainty, even as AEW currently enjoys strong television ratings and record-setting pay-per-view numbers.

stories.title: Actor Neil Patrick Harris on being a WWE fan: “It was kind of a tell for knowing I was gonna be gay”
stories.tldr: Actor Neil Patrick Harris recently discussed his childhood fandom of professional wrestling during an interview with Sam Roberts. Harris candidly shared that his strong attraction to the athletic performers served as an early indicator of his sexuality. He also noted that similar interests, such as collecting Masters of the Universe action figures while starring in Doogie Howser, pointed to the same realization.

stories.title: Jim Ross questions WWE’s motivation for running against AEW All Out
stories.tldr: AEW commentator and WWE Hall of Famer Jim Ross recently criticized WWE for scheduling an event head-to-head against AEW All Out in the same city. Speaking on his podcast, Ross argued that WWE's motivation was not to entertain fans or promote industry growth, citing the suspicious timing and the booking of CM Punk. He expressed frustration that the wrestling business often fails to realize promotions can help each other succeed. Meanwhile, questions remain regarding whether WWE Worlds Collide will be live streamed this weekend or eventually added to Club WWE.

stories.title: AEW Dynamite ticket sales update for this week’s show (09-22-2026)
stories.tldr: AEW Dynamite is heading to the Fishers Event Center in Fishers, Indiana, for a special three-hour live block combined with Collision, with 2,630 tickets currently distributed according to WrestleTix. While this marks a slight increase of 33 tickets over the previous day, the figures trail both AEW's year-to-date show average of 3,286 and the 3,284 tickets drawn during the company's last visit to the venue in December 2025. Standard admission tickets currently start at $37.35 with around 96 resale tickets available, and the event is expected to fall short of the 3,200 mark despite potential walk-up sales. Fans tuning into the broadcast will see a major card highlighted by an AEW World Trios Championship match featuring Swerve Strickland, Kofi, and Austin Creed defending against The Demand's Ricochet, Toa Liona, and Bishop Kaun, with the winners moving on to face Hangman and Brodido at AEW All Out.

stories.title: Top 10 pro wrestling matches on this day in history: September 22
stories.tldr: This historical retrospective highlights the top ten professional wrestling matches that took place on September 22, utilizing Cagematch ratings and prominent star ratings to rank them. Topping the list is the legendary 2021 non-title dream match between Bryan Danielson and Kenny Omega in All Elite Wrestling, which received a five-star rating. The list also features incredible bouts from promotions worldwide, including Dragongate, WWE, Big Japan, CHIKARA, Stardom, AAA, New Japan, Tokyo Joshi Pro, and SEAdLINNNG. Dave Meltzer's detailed analysis of the Danielson versus Omega encounter provides a deep dive into the pacing, storytelling, and high-impact moves that made it an instant classic.

stories.title: Jacari Ball Mocks Daejon Love Comparisons in “WWE Sent Me to Therapy” Video
stories.tldr: WWE ID talent Jacari Ball has released a new comedy video titled WWE sent me to therapy to lean even further into fan comparisons between his WWE Swindler character and Daejon Love. Playing both the therapist and himself in the sketch, Ball humorously defends his scammer persona, claims he was just getting reps with 17 recruits, and insists he is the solution rather than the problem. Despite previous playful protests that Love actually stole his method, Ball is now fully capitalizing on the viral joke to build his character.

stories.title: NXT’s Kendal Grey Shares Fears for Her Wrestling Future Amid Vertigo Struggle
stories.tldr: NXT star Kendal Grey opened up during an emotional therapy segment on the September 22 episode about her uncertain wrestling future while sidelined indefinitely with severe ear trauma and vertigo. The injury originally stemmed from an NXT Underground Match against Lola Vice and worsened while defending the NXT Women’s Championship against Kelani Jordan at Heatwave 2026, leading to a vestibular system injury and the loss of her title. Grey expressed deep emotional distress over not having a recovery timeline and fear that she might not return to the ring with the same physical abilities that defined her career.

stories.title: WWE NXT Championship match set for next week’s show
stories.tldr: Next week's episode of WWE NXT will feature two major championship matches, including Mason Rook challenging Grayson Waller for the NXT Championship after a heated war of words. In addition, NXT Women's North American Champion Zaria will defend her title against Thea Hail following a controversial backstage segment involving embarrassing school play footage. The broadcast will also showcase the return of Myles Borne after his vicious attack on Tavion Heights, alongside two opening round matches in the Dusty Rhodes Tag Team Classic tournament.

stories.title: Influencer Says She Will Not Reveal Mystery WWE Wrestler Behind Raya Referral
stories.tldr: Influencer Meredith Harris generated massive online curiosity after revealing that a former hookup currently working as a WWE wrestler used her as a referral to get onto the exclusive dating app Raya. Despite intense internet sleuthing and wild guesses from fans, Harris has firmly stated she has no intention of revealing the wrestler's identity. She recently took to Instagram to tell new followers that she does not care about wrestling and is keeping the secret to herself.

stories.title: Vince Russo announces departure from Juggalo Championship Wrestling
stories.tldr: Vince Russo has officially announced his departure from Juggalo Championship Wrestling after spending a year as an investor and creative showrunner for their weekly Lunacy program. Russo revealed on social media that he had been unhappy with the promotion for a while and needed time to evaluate his future before making a decision. Following an amicable phone conversation with Insane Clown Posse member Violent J, the two sides agreed to part ways. Russo expressed gratitude for his time with the company, praising the locker room, crew, and Violent J himself while noting that at age 65, his life and priorities have changed.

stories.title: Heated Confrontation Sets Up Mason Rook vs. Grayson Waller NXT Title Match
stories.tldr: During the September 22 episode of WWE NXT, champion Grayson Waller and challenger Mason Rook engaged in a deeply personal war of words ahead of their September 29 NXT Championship match. Waller mocked Rook with body-shaming jokes and insults about his work ethic and relationship with John Cena, while questioning his commitment. Rook fired back by referencing Waller's struggles on the main roster and failure to fit in with The Vision, vowing to choke out the champion. The fiery confrontation concluded with a tense face-to-face standoff to close the broadcast.

stories.title: Tommy Dreamer Says Solo Sikoa’s 946 Abduction Could Drive Him Back to His Family
stories.tldr: Wrestling veteran Tommy Dreamer believes that the recent abduction of Solo Sikoa by the group 946 on Monday Night Raw could force him to seek help from the family members he previously alienated. During an appearance on Busted Open, Dreamer analyzed how the angle removes Solo from his Money in the Bank qualifier and sets the stage for a broader fall storyline. He noted that this crisis gives Solo a narrative reason to repair fractured relationships while escalating the threat posed by Royce Keys and 946.

stories.title: Thea Hail Set For WWE NXT Women's NA Title Match
stories.tldr: Thea Hail has earned a shot at the WWE NXT Women's North American Championship and will challenge Zaria on next week's episode of NXT. Hail secured the opportunity after pinning Zaria during a tag team match that also featured La Catalina and Kelani Jordan. Hail has been eager to regain the championship ever since her short-lived initial reign ended in January. Meanwhile, Zaria enters the matchup defending a dominant reign that has lasted over 100 days following her victory over Tatum Paxley in June.

stories.title: Dorian Van Dux Sidelined With Punctured Lung in WWE NXT Ahead of Dusty Classic
stories.tldr: Dorian Van Dux is sidelined from WWE NXT action after suffering a punctured lung, placing his spot in the upcoming Dusty Rhodes Tag Team Classic in doubt. During a recent episode, Sean Legacy revealed the injury backstage and rightfully shot down Van Dux's insistence on wrestling anyway. EK Prosper stepped in as a replacement for that night's six-man tag team match alongside Legacy and Zilla Fatu. Unfortunately, the makeshift trio ultimately lost to BirthRight when Uriah Connors pinned Sean Legacy.

stories.title: First two teams advance in Dusty Rhodes Tag Team Classic
stories.tldr: The 2024 Dusty Rhodes Tag Team Classic has officially kicked off with the first two teams securing their spots in the next round during a recent event in Orlando. Romeo Moreno and Noam Dar defeated Los Americanos, while The Creed Brothers triumphed over Harley Riggins and Jax Presley of Evolve. The tournament features a diverse lineup from NXT, the main roster, AAA, and Evolve, with several powerhouse teams already waiting in the second round via byes. Action will continue next week with more crucial opening-round matchups.

stories.title: Bully Ray Calls Cody Rhodes’ SmackDown Interview ‘Polished and Soulless’
stories.tldr: Veteran wrestling personality Bully Ray recently criticized Cody Rhodes and his recent SmackDown interview with Michael Cole for feeling overly rehearsed and artificial. Speaking on radio, Bully explained that the immaculate suit, precise lighting, and measured delivery made the segment feel soulless when the storyline called for genuine frustration over recent betrayals. In contrast, he praised a supplementary clip showing a more ruthless side of Rhodes, though he questioned why management officially released the supposedly private moment. He concluded that WWE now needs to provide an on-screen explanation for why Rhodes would confront management over broadcasting the candid footage.

stories.title: WWE NXT Championship Match Set for September 29 After Heated Face-Off
stories.tldr: The NXT Championship match between champion Grayson Waller and challenger Mason Rook is officially set for the September 29 episode after a heated face-off on September 22. During their confrontation, Waller alternated between praising Rook and launching personal attacks, even dragging John Cena into the mix. Waller ultimately vowed to drown Rook and make him quit in next week's highly personal title showdown.

stories.title: NXT Star Returns After Two-Month TV Absence, Costs Kali Armstrong the Match
stories.tldr: Reina Volcan made her return to WWE NXT television on September 22 after a nearly two-month absence, disrupting a match between Kali Armstrong and Skylar Raye. Although she had stayed active on house shows and previously teased the beginning of the Volcan Era on social media, she made her on-screen statement by attacking both competitors while the referee was incapacitated. The chaos ultimately allowed Raye to capitalize and secure the tainted victory over Armstrong, signaling a violent and chaotic new chapter in the NXT women's division.

stories.title: Noam Dar & Romeo Moreno Advance as Cody Rhodes Gets Dusty Classic Role
stories.tldr: The 2026 Dusty Rhodes Tag Team Classic has officially kicked off on NXT, featuring a 14-team single-elimination tournament with talent from WWE and AAA. Noam Dar and Romeo Moreno secured the first spot in the next round by defeating Los Americanos in a hard-fought opening match. Meanwhile, The Creed Brothers also advanced with a pinfall victory over Harley Riggins and Jax Presley. Additionally, Cody Rhodes appeared in a special video package to announce that he will personally present the tournament trophy to the winning team at the conclusion of the event.

stories.title: Romeo Moreno, Noam Dar, And More Advance In WWE NXT Dusty Rhodes Tag Team Classic
stories.tldr: The 2026 WWE NXT Dusty Rhodes Tag Team Classic officially kicked off with the first round matchups taking place on television. Noam Dar and Romeo Moreno secured a hard-fought victory over Los Americanos to move forward in the tournament. Meanwhile, the Creed Brothers also advanced to the next round after defeating the WWE EVOLVE team of Jax Presley and Harley Riggins. Both winning teams now await the outcome of upcoming matches to determine their next opponents in the bracket.

stories.title: Second Team Advances in WWE NXT Dusty Rhodes Tag Team Classic
stories.tldr: The Dusty Rhodes Tag Team Classic field narrowed further during the September 22, 2026 episode of NXT as The Creed Brothers advanced to the next round. Julius and Brutus Creed overcame a tough challenge from Harley Riggins and Jax Presley, recovering from a momentary miscommunication during the match. They join Noam Dar and Romeo Moreno as the second team to officially secure their spot in the tournament. Fans are now discussing whether the powerhouse duo has what it takes to go all the way and claim the trophy.

stories.title: WWE NXT injury: Dorian Van Dux punctured lung hopefully won’t affect the Belgian’s impressive rise up the ranks
stories.tldr: Dorian Van Dux was ruled medically unable to compete on NXT due to a punctured lung, forcing him out of a scheduled six-man tag team match where EK Prosper replaced him alongside Sean Legacy and Zilla Fatu. Despite wanting to push through the injury, his partner Legacy insisted he follow medical advice to protect their status in the upcoming Dusty Rhodes Tag Team Classic. Van Dux and Legacy are considered among the favorites to win the entire tournament, where they are scheduled to face AAA's Tokyo Bad Boys in the first round. Fans and management alike are hoping for a quick recovery for the Belgian standout, whose impressive blend of power and speed has positioned him for a major breakout either as part of the tag division or as a future singles star.

stories.title: Oba Femi Isn’t Letting Bronson Reed’s WWE RAW Taunt Slide: ‘F— You’
stories.tldr: Oba Femi is seeking revenge against Bronson Reed after Reed disrespected him by placing a foot on his back during a recent attack on WWE RAW. Femi returned to the red brand on September 21 to clear the ring and directly challenge Reed to a one-on-one match with an explicit message. Both powerhouses acknowledge their intense rivalry stems from a mutual desire to be the top dog in the company.

stories.title: JBL Recalls Vince McMahon Making Booker T Apologize for a Joke McMahon Supplied
stories.tldr: Former WWE star JBL recently shared a bizarre backstage story on the Something to Wrestle podcast involving Vince McMahon and Booker T. According to JBL, McMahon fed Booker a potentially offensive dad joke to use on air, but then forgot he was the one who supplied it after someone backstage complained. Booker was subsequently forced to issue an apology for the line, which he accepted professionally without arguing with McMahon. The anecdote highlighted the intense and chaotic nature of McMahon's production style in Gorilla position while overseeing the broadcast team.

stories.title: Cody Rhodes’ Street Fighter Shoot Was Interrupted by a Huge Family Moment
stories.tldr: While filming the upcoming live-action Street Fighter movie where he stars as Guile, Cody Rhodes received the news that his second daughter had been born. He found out while lying on the ground during a scene where his character was taken out by Bison's crew. Despite the chaotic and humorous interruption of a co-star flatulating while everyone had to pretend to be dead, Rhodes kept his composure before quietly sharing the news and celebrating with a cigar on set.

stories.title: WWE Hall of Famer Announces New Podcast Ahead of Movie About His Iconic Character
stories.tldr: WWE Hall of Famer Sgt. Slaughter has announced a new monthly podcast titled That is An Order, which premieres on YouTube through the Golden Era Network. Co-hosted by Robert Remus and Marcus, the show will feature fan Q and As and career retrospectives covering his time in the WWF, AWA, Mid-Atlantic, and pop culture as a G.I. Joe character. This announcement comes shortly after Remus revealed that a live-action movie titled Slaughter: The Origin Story is currently in development. Remus is serving as an executive producer for the film, which will focus on a younger version of his iconic persona and fictional military background.

stories.title: Trick Williams’ Controversial T-Shirt Still Available After WWE Pull
stories.tldr: WWE quickly pulled Trick Williams and his controversial Lemon Pepper Steppers T-shirt from its United States online store following online criticism regarding racially insensitive imagery. The shirt, which featured a white shoe paired with lemon pepper chicken wings, was removed in less than twenty-four hours after going on sale on September 21. Despite the domestic removal, the merchandise remains available for purchase as a pre-order on the WWE Euroshop and other international regional storefronts. Neither WWE nor Williams has publicly commented on the controversy as Fanatics and WWE work to address the remaining regional listings.

stories.title: Janel Grant Describes The Aftermath Of Vince McMahon Allegations Becoming Public
stories.tldr: Janel Grant has detailed the devastating personal fallout she experienced when her sexual abuse and exploitation allegations against former WWE Chairman Vince McMahon became public. In a recent interview, Grant described the intense trauma, loss of privacy, and suicidal ideation she suffered after being contacted by the Wall Street Journal prior to their explosive 2022 report. Despite experiencing profound distress and questioning whether McMahon felt similarly isolated, her ongoing lawsuit against him was moved to private arbitration earlier this year.

stories.title: Matt Hardy Says Bad Creative and Perceived Favoritism Hurt Roman Reigns’ Early Push
stories.tldr: Wrestling veteran Matt Hardy recently discussed the early singles push of Roman Reigns, noting that the star had to overcome poor creative direction and audience backlash regarding perceived favoritism. Hardy pointed out that conflicting comedic material clashed with the serious top-star image WWE intended for Reigns during his initial run. Furthermore, discussions surrounding backstage protection during The Shield era contributed to fan resentment as Reigns continued receiving major WrestleMania opportunities. However, Hardy contrasted these early struggles with Reigns' modern success alongside Paul Heyman, noting that his current authentic presentation solidifies his status alongside Cody Rhodes as one of the two biggest stars in WWE today.

stories.title: Reina Volcan Returns to WWE NXT and Wrecks Kali Armstrong and Skylar Raye
stories.tldr: Reina Volcan made her explosive return to WWE NXT on September 22, 2026, after weeks of television absence following her July debut. During a singles match between Kali Armstrong and Skylar Raye, Volcan interfered after the referee was accidentally wiped out. She attacked both competitors, laying them out with dominant force and inadvertently helping Raye secure the victory. This chaotic comeback officially kicks off what Volcan has dubbed the Volcanca Era.

stories.title: Ex-WWE Star Set for AJPW Debut Two Years After NXT Exit
stories.tldr: Former WWE star Cal Bloom, formerly known as Von Wagner, is officially set to make his debut for All Japan Pro Wrestling in October. Bloom was released by WWE in April 2024 after a five-year run that included prominent feuds on the NXT brand with Bron Breakker and Lexis King. In AJPW, he will join the HAVOC stable, which was revealed via a vignette featuring stablemates Xyon Quinn, Odyssey, and Shotaro Ashino. His first appearance for the Japanese promotion is scheduled for October 22 at Korakuen Hall.

stories.title: Bully Ray On Cody Rhodes' Latest WWE SmackDown Segment: 'Polished And Soulless'
stories.tldr: Following his hesitation to punt Randy Orton at Sunday Night's Main Event, Cody Rhodes addressed the situation during a calm and composed interview on SmackDown. WWE Hall of Famer Bully Ray heavily criticized the segment on a recent radio appearance, describing Rhodes as polished and soulless due to his overly pristine appearance and lack of raw emotion. Ray argued that Rhodes should have shown more passion and frustration, suggesting he channel the disheveled intensity of his late father Dusty Rhodes.

stories.title: First Team Advances in WWE NXT Dusty Rhodes Tag Team Classic
stories.tldr: The 2026 WWE NXT Dusty Rhodes Tag Team Classic officially kicked off on September 22, 2026. Noam Dar and Romeo Moreno secured their spot in the next round by defeating Los Americanos in a hard-fought opening match. Despite a strong showing of power and high flying maneuvers from Rayo and Bravo Americano, Dar and Moreno capitalized on a late game opening to hit their finishing combination for the victory. They now await their next opponents as the tournament continues to unfold.

stories.title: WWE Raw’s Roman Reigns vs. Penta headlined episode hits highest viewership in five months
stories.tldr: The September 14 edition of WWE Raw on Netflix achieved its highest viewership in five months despite facing stiff NFL Monday Night Football competition. The episode drew 3.1 million global views, marking a significant increase from recent weeks and outperforming its rolling nine-week average. The broadcast was anchored by a marquee World Heavyweight Championship match between Roman Reigns and Penta originating from Mexico City. Additionally, the show featured an Intercontinental title bout and Money in the Bank qualifying matches, propelling it into top ten television rankings across 24 countries.

stories.title: How will the success of Zilla Fatu compare to the rest of The Bloodline in WWE?
stories.tldr: Zilla Fatu has made a massive impact in WWE NXT since his debut, quickly entering the championship picture and feuding with the multi-generational Birthright faction. Backed by heavy promotional support from WWE, he is expected to transition to the main roster soon to join his famous family members. Wrestling observers are already weighing his long-term potential against established Bloodline stars like Roman Reigns, Jacob Fatu, Jey Uso, and Solo Sikoa. Ultimately, WWE is positioning him as a major game changer, leaving it up to him to fulfill his immense potential.

stories.title: John Cena Reveals What He Looks For When Coaching Wrestlers
stories.tldr: John Cena recently praised Natalya and TJ Wilson for running The Dungeon 2.0, an invite-only training facility that charges wrestlers zero fees. During a recent convention appearance, Cena explained that he deeply admires their selflessness in investing time and money to mentor the next generation. When visiting the facility, Cena prefers to observe and offer feedback rather than demonstrate moves, focusing heavily on the importance of mastering the little things. He noted that modern stars like CM Punk and legends like Shawn Michaels excel at these minor details, which separate basic athletes from captivating performers.

stories.title: Wren Sinclair Gets Kicked Out of WWE NXT After Trying to Work Merch Truck During Suspension
stories.tldr: Suspended NXT star Wren Sinclair shocked officials by showing up to work the venue merchandise truck ahead of the September 22, 2026 episode. Robert Stone quickly intercepted her, reminding the rebellious wrestler that her suspension bars her from the property entirely. Despite fans chanting her name and security stepping in to escort her away, Sinclair refused to quietly stay home. Stone warned her that further antics could significantly worsen her ongoing punishment.

stories.title: CM Punk Confirmed For Guest Role On ABC’s ‘RJ Decker’ Tonight
stories.tldr: WWE star CM Punk is making his return to acting with a guest appearance on tonight's episode of the ABC series RJ Decker. He filmed his role for the second season earlier this month, which marks his first television or film role since starring in the January horror movie Night Patrol. Fans can catch his appearance tonight at 10 p.m. Eastern Time on ABC or stream it the next day on Hulu.

stories.title: Full 2026 Dusty Rhodes Tag Team Classic Bracket
stories.tldr: WWE has revealed the full 14-team bracket and first-round matchups for the 2026 Dusty Rhodes Tag Team Classic starting on NXT. The tournament features a mix of established tag teams, international stars, and reigning champions holding first-round byes. Action kicks off on the September 22 episode with a pair of opening-round bouts setting the stage for the road to the finals.

stories.title: Has the Men’s WWE Money in the Bank winner already been revealed?
stories.tldr: Four superstars have already qualified for the upcoming men Money in the Bank match, leaving only two spots undecided ahead of the October 10 event. Bron Breakker, Je Von Evans, Trick Williams, and Penta currently fill the confirmed slots, with CM Punk, GUNTHER, and Finn Balor competing for the next spot on SmackDown. Analysts are eyeing Breakker as a top contender, though ongoing rivalries and upcoming qualifying matches could drastically shift the odds.

stories.title: Influencer Rules Out Several WWE Names After Mystery Wrestler Raya Confession
stories.tldr: Social media influencer Meredith Harris recently caused a stir online by revealing that a former professional wrestler currently in WWE used her as a referral to join the exclusive dating app Raya. As curious fans bombard her social media with guesses, Harris has begun actively eliminating various names from the running. While she continues to keep the mystery wrestler's true identity under wraps, prominent names like Ricky Starks, Powerhouse Hobbs, Mick Foley, Batista, Goldberg, and Dolph Ziggler have all been officially ruled out.

stories.title: Dominik Mysterio & Omos: Why WWE must bring AAA alliance to the main roster
stories.tldr: Following the loss of his AAA Mega Championship to El Grande Americano at TripleMania 34, former champion Dominik Mysterio should bring his new alliance with Omos to the WWE main roster. Dominik has reportedly grown frustrated with his current direction in the Judgment Day, where he feels underutilized and frequently loses matches. Meanwhile, Omos has proven his value through recent high-profile appearances in AAA and Pro Wrestling NOAH. Pairing the cowardly heel Dominik with the towering 7 foot 4 giant creates a natural dynamic where Omos serves as special-attraction backup, successfully revitalizing both superstars on Raw or SmackDown.

stories.title: Neil Patrick Harris Says His Childhood WWE Fandom Was an Early Sign He Was Gay
stories.tldr: Actor Neil Patrick Harris recently revealed in an interview with Sam Roberts that his childhood obsession with WWE was an early indicator of his sexuality. Looking back, Harris joked that the oiled-up wrestlers, tight gear, and grappling caught his attention a little more than the actual wrestling itself. He noted that this secret fandom, along with collecting Masters of the Universe action figures, coincided with his early years starring on Doogie Howser, M.D.

stories.title: Full Bracket For 2026 Dusty Rhodes Tag Team Classic Revealed Ahead Of WWE NXT
stories.tldr: WWE has officially revealed the 14-team bracket for the 2026 Dusty Rhodes Tag Team Classic, featuring talent across NXT, Raw, SmackDown, AAA, and Evolve. The tournament kicks off tonight on NXT with opening-round matches including Rayo and Bravo Americano facing Noam Dar and Romeo Moreno. An analysis of the bracket suggests that newer duos like Sean Legacy and Dorian Van Dux stand out as prime candidates to win the entire tournament and challenge for the titles.

stories.title: Roman Reigns, Rey Mysterio & AJ Lee: What will their WWE retirement matches be?
stories.tldr: Roman Reigns, Rey Mysterio, and AJ Lee are current or recent WWE roster members who are already contemplating their eventual in-ring retirements. Reigns is leaning toward a high-profile passing of the torch match, potentially against fellow Bloodline member Jacob Fatu, while Mysterio hopes to share his final moments in the ring with his children, Dominik and Aalyah. AJ Lee remains focused on story-driven opportunities that break new ground rather than relying solely on past rivalries. Ultimately, WWE will likely turn these eventual departures into major spectacles rather than letting these iconic stars go quietly into the night.

stories.title: Oba Femi calls out Bronson Reed following controversial WWE Raw moment: ‘You step on my face, f**k you’
stories.tldr: Oba Femi has issued a fiery challenge to Bronson Reed following a controversial moment on WWE Raw where Reed placed his foot on Oba's back to assert dominance. The tension stems from Reed's return at Sunday Night's Main Event and subsequent attacks alongside the Vision, leading to a viral social media clip of Oba knocking Reed's foot away. Following his return on the latest episode of Raw to save Je'Von Evans, Oba explicitly called out Reed for a one-on-one match with the message that stepping on his face brings severe consequences. This escalating feud points toward an inevitable collision between the two heavyweights, potentially culminating at the upcoming Wrestlepalooza event in Australia this December.

stories.title: Full 2026 WWE Dusty Rhodes Tag Team Classic Tournament Bracket
stories.tldr: WWE has officially revealed the complete 14-team bracket for the 2026 Dusty Rhodes Tag Team Classic ahead of its premiere on NXT. The tournament features a mix of top NXT tandems, international stars, and reigning champions vying for the prestigious trophy. First-round byes were awarded to NXT Tag Team Champions Vanity Project and AAA Tag Team Champions El Hijo de Dr. Wagner Jr. and Galeno. Action kicks off tonight with the first two opening-round matches setting the stage for the road to the finals.

stories.title: New hosts for WWE Radio, including a recently retired top star
stories.tldr: SiriusXM and WWE Radio are looking to expand their 24/7 audio programming by adding current and recently retired wrestling stars as hosts. Proposed additions to the lineup include unique pairings and personalities like The Miz and Kit Wilson, Joe Hendry, Danhausen, and recently retired legend John Cena. This strategy leverages talent under contract to provide fresh interview and talk show content beyond traditional television programming. These new audio projects would join existing podcasts and shows on the platform hosted by names like Cody Rhodes and Stephanie McMahon.

stories.title: John Cena Names CM Punk, Roman Reigns, Cody Rhodes & Others As Masters Of “The Little Things”
stories.tldr: During a recent appearance at the Edmonton Fan Expo, John Cena praised Natalya and TJ Wilson for running The Dungeon 2.0 training facility free of charge for invited wrestlers. Cena explained that his coaching visits focus on emphasizing the critical importance of mastering small details in the ring rather than just performing athletic stunts. To illustrate this point, he named top stars like CM Punk, Roman Reigns, Cody Rhodes, Sami Zayn, and Shawn Michaels as masters of these little things. Natalya later expressed immense gratitude on social media for Cena's time, mentorship, and ongoing generosity.

stories.title: Has the Women’s WWE Money in the Bank winner already been revealed?
stories.tldr: Four competitors have officially qualified for the women Money in the Bank ladder match, with the remaining spots to be finalized on upcoming episodes of SmackDown. Analysts are already evaluating the chances of stars like Sol Ruca, Lola Vice, Jacy Jayne, and Roxanne Perez to determine if a frontrunner has emerged. Roxanne Perez stands out as a particularly intriguing candidate due to her ties with The Judgment Day and potential friction with Liv Morgan. The premium live event is scheduled for October 10 at the Smoothie King Center in New Orleans, featuring a loaded match card alongside the ladder bouts.

stories.title: New WWE tag team likely debuting soon as Jordynne Grace & Ivy Nile form powerful partnership
stories.tldr: Jordynne Grace and Ivy Nile are reportedly slated to form a powerful new women's tag team upon their impending WWE returns. Both competitors have been out of action due to injuries and creative shifts, with Nile's former faction American Made officially dissolving following Chad Gable's babyface turn. The duo is expected to bond over their shared passion for bodybuilding, potentially positioning them as immediate challengers to current WWE Women's Tag Team Champions Fatal Influence.

stories.title: Money In The Bank 2026: different ways WWE stars could make history in New Orleans
stories.tldr: WWE Money In The Bank 2026 takes place on October 10 in New Orleans with most match lineups finalized, though several SmackDown spots remain open. Multiple WWE Superstars have the opportunity to break historic records during the upcoming event. Potential milestones include setting new benchmarks for the youngest male and female winners, the fastest main roster transition to victory, the oldest winner, and the first-ever three-time winner.

stories.title: WWE reveals full bracket for Dusty Rhodes Tag Team Classic 2026
stories.tldr: WWE has released the official 14-team bracket for the 2026 Dusty Rhodes Tag Team Classic, which kicks off tonight on NXT. The tournament features talent from across various brands, though notably absent of any TNA teams despite the ongoing NXT-TNA partnership. Vanity Project and The Wagner Brothers have secured first-round byes, while the rest of the field battles through opening matches leading to the finals.

stories.title: Ruthless Aggression Era star to be inducted into 2027 WWE Hall of Fame: Three 2000s stars that could join next year’s class
stories.tldr: As anticipation builds for the 2027 WWE Hall of Fame ceremony, wrestling observers are looking at potential headliners from the Ruthless Aggression Era. Following recent precedents of early inductee announcements, three major 2000s stars stand out as prime candidates. John Cena, the late Umaga, and Brock Lesnar are all highlighted as top contenders due to their massive and lasting impact on the wrestling industry.

stories.title: Janel Grant Discusses Forgiveness And Empathy Toward Vince McMahon
stories.tldr: Janel Grant, the former WWE employee who filed a 2024 federal lawsuit against Vince McMahon, WWE, and John Laurinaitis alleging sexual assault and sex trafficking, recently opened up about her current emotional state regarding McMahon. In a detailed new interview, Grant surprisingly expressed feelings of forgiveness and empathy toward the former WWE Chairman. She clarified that her mind is primarily occupied by the broader series of events and decision-makers leading up to the Wall Street Journal report rather than McMahon himself. Her allegations and the corresponding legal battle remain ongoing and unresolved.

stories.title: Big Vinny V: Why Fraxiom should win NXT’s Dusty Rhodes Tag Team Classic
stories.tldr: Nathan Frazer and Axiom, known as Fraxiom, are positioned as the ideal winners for NXT's upcoming Dusty Rhodes Tag Team Classic featuring fourteen teams. Despite their stellar performances across both nights of TripleMania 34 and a strong reputation that earned them second place in the 2024 Wrestling Observer Newsletter tag team voting, they have seen limited main roster use on SmackDown. The tournament aims to crown new challengers for NXT Tag Team Champions the Vanity Project, making Fraxiom the logical choice to elevate the division and anchor the bracket alongside other notable entrants like the Creed Brothers and the Wagner Brothers.

stories.title: WWE RAW 9/14/26 Draws Largest Global Netflix Audience Since Post-WrestleMania Episode
stories.tldr: The September 14, 2026 episode of WWE Raw held in Mexico City drew a massive global Netflix audience of 3.1 million views, marking the show's highest viewership since the post-WrestleMania episode in April. This performance resulted in a 19 percent week-over-week increase compared to the September 7 edition, which brought in 2.6 million views. The strong numbers highlight the ongoing success of Raw's weekly broadcasts since transitioning to the streaming platform.

stories.title: WWE Drops Attempt To Trademark Lola Vice’s “Vice City” Name
stories.tldr: WWE has officially abandoned its trademark application for the Vice City nickname associated with Lola Vice. The company originally filed for the trademark in August ahead of her transition to the main roster, but later submitted an express abandonment in September. Although fans previously speculated about potential naming conflicts with the Grand Theft Auto video game franchise, WWE provided no official reason for dropping the filing. Despite this legal change, the company continues to use the Vice City moniker on television and social media as Vice transitions to the Raw brand.

stories.title: WWE Quietly Moves Two Longtime Veterans To Alumni Section
stories.tldr: WWE has quietly moved longtime veterans Titus O Neil and Bobby Roode from its active roster page to the official website alumni section. Neither move has been formally addressed by WWE, but both men remain employed by the company in non-wrestling capacities. O Neil continues to serve as a global ambassador and community leader, while Roode works behind the scenes as a producer following career-pausing neck surgeries.

stories.title: Drake Maverick clears up his WWE status after indie return
stories.tldr: Drake Maverick recently returned to in-ring competition for PROGRESS Wrestling under his old TNA name, Rockstar Spud, marking his first match in nearly five years. This appearance led to fan speculation about his employment status with WWE, prompting Maverick to clarify on social media that he still works full-time as a backstage writer and producer. Maverick also revealed that his PROGRESS bookings came together with short notice and emphasized that he has not given up on eventually returning to the ring or headlining WrestleMania in some capacity.

stories.title: WOL: RAW report, World’s Collide vs. All Out, lack of Dynamite card, more
stories.tldr: Wrestling Observer Live returns with hosts Bryan Alvarez and Lance Storm discussing the latest professional wrestling news and events. The duo breaks down Monday Night RAW and questions the strategic reasoning behind WWE running the Worlds Collide event. Additionally, they examine the lack of announced matches for the upcoming Dynamite television broadcast, which features a significant runtime.

stories.title: IYO SKY’s Humble Response To Michael Cole Calling Her ‘The Best Wrestler On The Planet’
stories.tldr: WWE star IYO SKY recently responded to commentator Michael Cole frequently labeling her as the best wrestler on the planet. During an appearance on The Ringer Wrestling Show, SKY expressed deep gratitude for the praise while remaining humble about her status in the industry. Additionally, she discussed her career longevity, noting that unlike her favorite wrestler Rey Mysterio, she does not plan to wrestle into her fifties due to the physical toll of her high-risk style.

stories.title: IYO SKY gives humble response to being called best wrestler in the world
stories.tldr: IYO SKY recently responded with humility when asked about commentary praising her as the best wrestler in the world, expressing deep gratitude while stopping short of claiming the title for herself. During a recent podcast interview, she also discussed her wrestling style and why she does not expect to match the longevity of her idol, Rey Mysterio. Additionally, she shared her joy over global fan recognition and outlined her next career goal of winning singles gold, despite suffering a recent setback on Raw.

stories.title: Former WWE Star Simone Johnson Reflects On Whether Her In-Ring Career Is Over
stories.tldr: Former WWE NXT star Simone Johnson, daughter of Dwayne The Rock Johnson, recently discussed her wrestling future and departure from the company during an appearance on Cody Rhodes' show. Having competed in just six matches in 2023 before transitioning into a general manager role, Johnson revealed she is open to returning to the ring once she heals from lingering injuries. She also opened up about her decision not to renew her contract earlier this year, citing a lack of growth opportunities and a desire to experience life outside of the wrestling industry.

stories.title: Janel Grant Says She Feels 'Forgiveness' Towards Former WWE CEO Vince McMahon
stories.tldr: Janel Grant, the former WWE employee who previously filed a lawsuit accusing former CEO Vince McMahon of sex trafficking and abuse, recently stated that she feels forgiveness and empathy toward him. The legal battle officially concluded this past July after all parties agreed to move the case to private arbitration. During a recent interview, Grant reflected on the events triggered by the Wall Street Journal reports and anonymous emails, noting how the ensuing fallout impacted all parties involved.

stories.title: Former WWE NXT wrestler to make AJPW debut
stories.tldr: Former WWE NXT wrestler Cal Bloom, formerly known as Von Wagner, is scheduled to make his All Japan Pro Wrestling debut at Korakuen Hall in Tokyo on October 22. He will join the stable Havoc, which already features fellow former NXT alumni Xyon Quinn and Odyssey Jones. Bloom spent six years under contract with WWE before his release and has wrestled only sporadically on the independent scene since 2024. This upcoming tour marks the second-generation star's first-ever professional wrestling appearance in Japan.

stories.title: WWE Confirms First Match For 2026 Dusty Rhodes Tag-Team Classic
stories.tldr: WWE has officially announced the opening match for the 2026 Dusty Rhodes Tag Team Classic, which kicks off on tonight's episode of WWE NXT. The tournament features a 14-team single-elimination field, with Los Americanos facing Noam Dar and Romeo Moreno in the first-round opener. Meanwhile, NXT Tag Team Champions The Vanity Project and AAA World Tag Team Champions El Hijo de Dr. Wagner Jr. and Galeno have earned first-round byes into the second round.

stories.title: Nic Nemeth Comments On WWE NXT Tournament Not Including TNA Talent
stories.tldr: TNA World Heavyweight and Tag Team Champion Nic Nemeth recently addressed the absence of TNA talent from the upcoming Dusty Rhodes Tag Team Classic on WWE NXT. While the brackets feature teams from NXT, WWE EVOLVE, and AAA, Nemeth is unbothered by TNA being left out due to his busy schedule. He remains positive about the working relationship between the two companies and expects future crossover moments when the timing is right.

stories.title: WWE announces two matches for 2026 Dusty Rhodes Classic on NXT
stories.tldr: WWE has officially kicked off the 2026 Dusty Rhodes Tag Team Classic by announcing the first two tournament matches for tonight's episode of NXT. Los Americanos will face Noam Dar and Romeo Moreno, while The Creed Brothers will take on Harley Riggins and Jaxson Presley in opening round action. The massive 14-team single-elimination tournament features byes for NXT Tag Team Champions The Vanity Project and AAA World Tag Team Champions El Hijo de Dr. Wagner Jr. and Galeno. Tonight's stacked NXT lineup on The CW also features several non-tournament matches rounding out the card.

stories.title: Another WWE Veteran Turned Backstage Producer Moved To Alumni Section
stories.tldr: Bobby Roode has been quietly moved to the alumni section of WWE's official roster page alongside Titus O'Neil. Despite this administrative update, there is no indication that Roode's employment status has changed as he continues his work behind the scenes. Roode last wrestled in 2022 and has successfully transitioned into a full-time backstage producer role following multiple neck surgeries.

stories.title: Oba Femi Puts The Vision On Notice After 9/21 WWE Raw Ends
stories.tldr: Following the September 21 episode of WWE Raw, Oba Femi issued a stern warning to The Vision after coming to the aid of Je Von Evans. The chaos began when an impromptu match between Evans and Bron Breakker ended in a no contest due to interference and an attack from the faction. Femi quickly evened the odds by physically using Evans as a projectile against their attackers, later explaining that the group lacks true leadership or direction. Looking ahead, Evans shifted his focus to the upcoming Money in the Bank premium live event on October 10th in New Orleans, where he aims to become the youngest winner in history with Femi backing him up.

stories.title: Titus O’Neil, Robert Roode moved to alumni section of WWE roster
stories.tldr: WWE has moved long-inactive veterans Titus O Neil and Robert Roode to the alumni section of its official website roster. Both men remain with the company in non-wrestling capacities, with O Neil working as an ambassador and Roode serving as a backstage producer. Neither individual has competed in years, and it remains unconfirmed if the website update reflects any official change in their employment or retirement status.

stories.title: Former WWE Star Gurv Sihra Suffered Collapsed Lung During Recent Indie Match
stories.tldr: Former WWE star Gurv Sihra of The Bollywood Boyz suffered a collapsed right lung during a recent match for Pure Power Wrestling after taking an impact from a familiar move. Despite struggling to breathe, he managed to finish the match before collapsing backstage and requiring emergency transport to the hospital. Doctors told him he was lucky to be alive, and Sihra has expressed deep gratitude to the medical staff, locker room, and his brother for their quick response.

stories.title: Dave Meltzer Says WWE Initially Planned To Give Former Star A Brock Lesnar-Like Push
stories.tldr: Former Olympic gold medalist Gable Steveson recently suffered a devastating twelve-second knockout loss in MMA amid resurfaced past allegations. Following his success at the 2021 Tokyo Olympic Games, WWE originally planned to give him an immediate Brock Lesnar-style push. However, officials ultimately scrapped these plans because he did not progress fast enough in the ring or develop the necessary charisma and speaking skills. WWE released him in 2024 after concluding that his high main-roster-level salary could no longer be justified.

stories.title: CMLL surprised by crowd reaction to Místico vs. Averno at 93rd Anniversary | Exclusive
stories.tldr: CMLL officials were reportedly caught off guard by the crowd's vocal reaction during the main event mask versus hair match between Místico and Averno at the recent Arena Mexico anniversary show. Because the event sold out instantly to hardcore local fans rather than the usual tourist heavy demographic, the audience passionately cheered for the rudo Averno. Fans allegedly chose to back Averno because they anticipated the match outcome and wanted to show support before he lost his hair to Místico.

stories.title: Janel Grant Says She Feels “Empathy” And “Forgiveness” Toward Vince McMahon
stories.tldr: Janel Grant recently opened up in a new interview about her ongoing journey processing the trauma surrounding her high-profile lawsuit against Vince McMahon. Grant originally filed the lawsuit in January 2024, accusing McMahon of sexual assault and sex trafficking, though he has denied the allegations. Despite the severe impact on her life, Grant revealed that she now surprisingly feels a sense of forgiveness and empathy toward McMahon. The civil case has since been voluntarily dismissed as all parties involved agreed to move the dispute into private arbitration.

stories.title: Janel Grant says she feels ‘forgiveness’ toward Vince McMahon
stories.tldr: In her first media interview regarding the ongoing legal situation, Janel Grant revealed that she feels a sense of forgiveness and empathy toward Vince McMahon despite the severe allegations of abuse she leveled against him. Grant discussed her history of survival, including childhood sexual assault, and how she has channeled her experiences into becoming an advocate for non-disclosure agreement reform. Her lawsuit against McMahon, which led to his resignation from WWE and TKO Group, moved to private arbitration earlier this summer.

stories.title: Veteran WWE Superstar Status In Question After Profile Moved To WWE Alumni Section (UPDATED)
stories.tldr: Longtime WWE veteran and Global Ambassador Titus O'Neil has been moved to the official alumni section on the company website, sparking questions about his current employment status. Although he has not wrestled since late 2020, O'Neil remained active with community outreach and special appearances, such as commentating at WrestleMania 39. While no formal departure has been officially confirmed by the organization, the roster shift suggests a change in his association. An additional update notes that another WWE veteran who worked as a backstage producer has also been transitioned to the alumni directory.

stories.title: Bret Hart To Share Behind-The-Scenes Stories During WrestleMania X Watch-Along
stories.tldr: WWE Hall of Famer Bret The Hitman Hart is hosting an exclusive watch-along event dedicated to his iconic WrestleMania X match against his late brother Owen Hart. Scheduled for October 3, 2026, the intimate gathering will feature live commentary from Hart as he shares behind-the-scenes stories and memories from that historic night. Attendees will also hear his perspective on capturing the WWE Championship from Yokozuna later in the same evening. The limited-seating event requires reservations through hitmansbar.com and supports The Children's Hospital Foundation.

stories.title: New Development In Lawsuit Over WWE’s Move To ESPN Unlimited
stories.tldr: ESPN and BAMTech have been officially added as defendants in a class action lawsuit concerning WWE's transition to ESPN Unlimited. The plaintiffs allege that WWE misled customers into believing that premium live events would be included with their existing cable or streaming subscriptions without extra costs. While some television providers allowed authentication through the ESPN app, users with other providers were forced to purchase the separate $29.99 monthly service. Both WWE, ESPN, and BAMTech are now arguing that the dispute should be handled through arbitration based on the service terms agreed to by the subscribers.

stories.title: Kevin Nash Reveals WWE Nearly Did A Full Kliq Storyline: “I F**ked That Up …”
stories.tldr: Kevin Nash recently revealed that WWE nearly executed a television storyline featuring the legendary backstage group known as the Kliq in 2002. With Nash, Scott Hall, Shawn Michaels, and Triple H all under the WWE umbrella at the same time, creative possibilities were wide open following Michaels and Triple H returning alongside the Outsiders. However, those plans were permanently derailed when Nash suffered a severe torn quad muscle during a match in July 2002. Nash admitted on his podcast that his premature return from a biceps injury directly contributed to the mishap, ruining what could have been an iconic faction angle on screen.

stories.title: Booker T Compares LA Knight To WWE Legends Who Never Won The World Title
stories.tldr: WWE Hall of Famer Booker T recently discussed LA Knight's trajectory in the company on his podcast, noting that immense talent does not guarantee a world championship reign. He compared Knight's situation to legendary performers like Curt Hennig, Scott Hall, and Roddy Piper, who were massive stars but never captured a major WWE world title. Booker also reflected on his own career, emphasizing that financial success and being the best worker in the locker room mattered more to him than holding championships. As Knight prepares for his upcoming high-profile matches, Booker remains realistic about the wrestling business, where not everyone is meant to hold the belt.

stories.title: IYO SKY Says Rhea Ripley “Definitely” Needed Time Away From WWE
stories.tldr: IYO SKY recently discussed her former tag team partner Rhea Ripley's current sidelining due to a knee injury. Although they rarely speak due to SKY's personal preferences, SKY completely understands why Ripley needed a break from the ring. SKY noted that Ripley was severely overworked with grueling international travel, main events, and media obligations prior to her surgery. Despite the unfortunate timing, SKY believes Ripley will use this recovery period to return much stronger than before.

stories.title: Royce Keys Reveals Aftermath Of Kidnapping Of Solo Sikoa On WWE Raw
stories.tldr: The faction known as 946 has ramped up its violent feud with The Bloodline by kidnapping Solo Sikoa during Monday night's episode of WWE Raw. The abduction prevented Sikoa from competing in a Money in the Bank qualifier match, allowing Penta to take his place and advance to the ladder match. Following the broadcast, Royce Keys shared chilling footage of the bound Sikoa on social media, taunting him about his family's lack of loyalty. Keys and the group ultimately left a blindfolded Sikoa stranded and terrified on a deserted road after psychological intimidation involving a lit lighter.

stories.title: WWE Pulls New Trick Williams Shirt From Online Store Following Fan Criticism
stories.tldr: WWE quickly pulled a new Trick Williams t-shirt from its online store after fans criticized the design, which featured lemon pepper wings surrounding his trademark Lemon Pepper Steppers shoe, claiming it had racist undertones. This incident draws immediate parallels to a 2019 controversy involving former wrestler Jordan Myles, though Williams has not yet commented on the removal. Meanwhile, Williams continues to excel in his professional career, having recently qualified for the upcoming Money in the Bank ladder match and regained the United States Championship.

stories.title: WWE's Rey Mysterio Comments On Coming Full Circle As General Manager Of AAA
stories.tldr: WWE Hall of Famer Rey Mysterio is reflecting on his career and his new role as General Manager of Lucha Libre AAA Worldwide. Mysterio admits he never expected to take on a management position, viewing the opportunity as a full-circle moment given his history with the company. He famously performed at the very first AAA show in 1992 and the inaugural TripleMania event in 1993. Now, as GM, he is focused on creating opportunities for the current generation, including a groundbreaking tournament where a AAA wrestler can earn a match against Roman Reigns.

stories.title: IYO SKY sees silver lining in Rhea Ripley WWE injury
stories.tldr: Former WWE Women's Tag Team Champions IYO SKY and Rhea Ripley, once known as Rhiyo, share a close bond despite their on-screen partnership ending earlier this year. While SKY hates to see Ripley sidelined by a recent meniscus tear and subsequent surgery, she believes the enforced downtime is a much-needed blessing in disguise due to Ripley's grueling, non-stop schedule. Ripley, who previously suffered a backstage panic attack in October 2025 due to extreme overworking, is currently recognized as the WWE Women's Champion while Chelsea Green serves as interim champion. SKY remains confident that her friend will use this recovery period to return even stronger than before.

stories.title: WWE Pulls Controversial Trick Williams Chicken T-Shirt Almost Immediately
stories.tldr: WWE has quickly removed a new Trick Williams Lemon Pepper Steppers T-shirt from its United States online shop following immediate fan backlash. The controversial design featured artwork of chicken wings dunked into a shoe, which drew criticism on social media for being low-effort and playing into racial stereotypes. While the item was pulled from the U.S. storefront, it remained available on the European online shop at the time of reporting. This merchandise misstep follows another recent controversy where the company had to replace a 9/11 anniversary shirt due to quality complaints.

stories.title: WWE pulls Trick Williams ‘Lemon Pepper Steppers’ shirt after backlash
stories.tldr: WWE has removed a new Trick Williams Lemon Pepper Steppers t-shirt from its US online shop following significant fan backlash on social media. The design, which featured chicken wings being dunked into a shoe, faced heavy criticism for being low effort and drew allegations of playing on racial stereotypes. Williams originally coined the phrase to describe his fashionable footwear, and while the item is gone from the US storefront, it remains available on the European shop. The controversy follows a separate recent incident where WWE had to update a 9/11 anniversary shirt design due to poor quality complaints.

stories.title: Bryan Alvarez’s WWE Raw September 21 report for subscribers
stories.tldr: Wrestling observer analyst Bryan Alvarez has officially released his post show report covering the September 21 episode of Monday Night Raw. The comprehensive breakdown is currently accessible for all dedicated subscribers of the platform. Fans can now access the full analysis to read his exclusive insights on the matches, segments, and overall direction of the weekly television broadcast.

stories.title: Booker T on LA Knight’s WWE World title chances: ‘Everybody’s not going to be the champion’
stories.tldr: WWE Hall of Famer Booker T recently discussed LA Knight's world title prospects ahead of his match against Roman Reigns, noting that being an incredible talent does not guarantee a world championship reign. Comparing Knight to legendary non-world champions like Curt Hennig, Scott Hall, and Roddy Piper, Booker argued that the wrestling business does not owe everyone a turn with the belt. Booker also shared his own career philosophy, emphasizing that financial security and being the best worker in the locker room mattered more to him than holding the top championship, even though he notably won WWE's World Heavyweight Championship as King Booker in 2006.

stories.title: WWE Drops Recently Filed Trademark For New Main Roster Superstar
stories.tldr: WWE has abandoned its trademark application for the term Vice City, which was initially filed ahead of Lola Vice moving to the main roster. Although WWE submitted an express abandonment and the U.S. Patent and Trademark Office processed it with no reason listed, the company continues to use the Vice City moniker on television and social media. Meanwhile, Vice has officially joined the Raw brand and is set to compete in the Women Money In The Bank Ladder Match.

stories.title: WWE Hall Of Fame Legend Sgt. Slaughter Announces New Monthly Podcast
stories.tldr: WWE Hall of Famer Sgt. Slaughter is expanding into the digital media space by launching a new monthly podcast titled That's An Order. Premiering this Wednesday on YouTube, the show will feature the wrestling legend answering fan questions and sharing memorable stories from his storied career. This exciting audio announcement closely follows his recent revelation last week that a live-action movie based on his iconic character is also currently in development.

stories.title: WWE's Danhausen Wants Return To Classic Survivor Series Match As Opposed To WarGames
stories.tldr: Since WWE replaced the traditional five-on-five elimination matches at Survivor Series with WarGames in 2022, some talent have expressed a desire for the original format to return. Danhausen recently voiced his preference for the classic Survivor Series style over the multi-ring cage match during a media appearance. Meanwhile, WWE CCO Paul Triple H Levesque previously noted that the old Raw versus SmackDown format had grown tired, leading to the current reliance on WarGames. Despite calls from talent for the traditional format, WWE plans to feature WarGames once again at the upcoming event in Houston, Texas.

stories.title: WWE abandons Lola Vice-related trademark filing
stories.tldr: WWE has officially abandoned its trademark filing for the term Vice City, which was initially submitted ahead of Lola Vice moving to the main roster. Although the paperwork was dropped without a stated reason, fan speculation had previously linked the filing to potential naming conflicts with the Grand Theft Auto video game franchise. Despite dropping the trademark application, WWE continues to use the Vice City nickname on television and social media for Vice, who recently made her main roster in-ring debut and signed her official Raw brand contract. Meanwhile, WWE's trademark for the ring name Lola Vice, which she adopted after transitioning from Bellator MMA, remains completely active.

stories.title: WWE Hall of Famer launching podcast ahead of live-action movie release
stories.tldr: WWE Hall of Famer Sgt. Slaughter is launching a new monthly YouTube podcast titled That's an Order this Wednesday, where he will answer fan questions and share career stories. The announcement comes on the heels of another major project reveal regarding a live-action movie based on his iconic fictional military character. Slaughter, a decorated legend inducted into the WWE Hall of Fame in 2004 and the Wrestling Observer Newsletter Hall of Fame in 2023, is urging fans to support the upcoming film by engaging with its teaser scene.

stories.title: Nic Nemeth says Leon Slater could be ‘running pro wrestling for the next 20 years’
stories.tldr: TNA World Champion Nic Nemeth recently offered high praise for 21-year-old rising star Leon Slater ahead of their upcoming title match. Nemeth commended Slater for his exceptional athleticism, high ring IQ, and humility, predicting he could lead the professional wrestling industry for the next twenty years. Despite acknowledging Slater's immense talent and potential to become the youngest TNA champion ever, Nemeth made it clear he has no intention of losing their championship bout. The two competitors are scheduled to clash for the TNA World Championship at TNA Bound for Glory on October 11, 2026.

stories.title: Kevin Nash reveals what derailed potential WWE Kliq angle with Shawn Michaels, Triple H
stories.tldr: WWE legend Kevin Nash recently revealed that a major on-screen angle involving the legendary backstage group The Kliq was scrapped because of his unfortunate leg injury. The storyline would have united Nash, Shawn Michaels, Triple H, and Scott Hall on screen during a rare window when all four members were active in WWE simultaneously. Nash unfortunately blew out his quad on his very first night back from a torn bicep after returning three weeks ahead of schedule, instantly killing the creative plans. Consequently, the four men never worked an official program together in WWE, leaving their infamous 1996 Madison Square Garden curtain call as their most notable shared legacy.

stories.title: Title Changes On This Day in Wrestling (September 22nd)
stories.tldr: September 22 holds a significant place in professional wrestling history, having hosted 276 major and notable title changes over the decades. Historic moments span multiple eras, from early Mexican National Light Heavyweight Championship changes in 1944 to legendary bouts involving icons like Terry Funk, Trish Stratus, and Jay White. The date has also seen chaotic championship activity, such as multiple 24/7 title changes in 2019, alongside notable reigns in WWE, WCW, ROH, and Japan.

stories.title: WOR: Paramount/Skydance/WBD breakdown, RAW, injury news, more!
stories.tldr: The latest episode of Wrestling Observer Radio hosted by Bryan Alvarez and Dave Meltzer covers a wide range of combat sports and professional wrestling news. Major topics include the business implications of the Paramount, Skydance, and Warner Bros Discovery media deals on wrestling, MMA, and boxing. The show also provides crucial injury and legal updates regarding Gurv Shirah, Kota Ibushi, and Sanga, alongside a complete review of WWE Monday Night Raw and CMLL notes.

stories.title: WWE NXT Start Time Tonight (09-22-2026)
stories.tldr: WWE NXT airs live tonight from the WWE Performance Center in Orlando, Florida, on the CW network. The packed episode features the kickoff of the 2026 Dusty Rhodes Tag Team Classic tournament. Fans can also look forward to high-stakes tag team action, including Zilla Fatu, Sean Legacy, and Dorian Van Dux facing Birth Right, alongside La Catalina and Thea Hail taking on Kelani Jordan and Zaria.

stories.title: Maika Pins Fuwa-chan in STARDOM Homecoming Match After Mexico Tour
stories.tldr: Maika successfully returned from her tour of Mexico by pinning Fuwa-chan in the main event of STARDOM's Silver Week Tour stop in Fukuoka on September 22. Teaming with Maki Itoh and Utami Hayashishita, Maika secured the victory with a Michinoku Driver II after a hard-fought battle against Fuwa-chan, Hazuki, and Koguma. Following the match, the competitors addressed the crowd, with Maika revealing that her return trip was complicated by a flight cancellation due to an approaching typhoon.

stories.title: TJPW Brings Back Rookie-Only BECOMING Show, Sets Kamifuku’s Final Hometown Event
stories.tldr: Tokyo Joshi Pro Wrestling has announced the return of its rookie-focused BECOMING 2 event, scheduled for December 19 at TOKYO SQUARE in Itabashi, featuring only wrestlers who debuted in 2023 or later such as Wakana Uehara and HIMAWARI. Additionally, the promotion set Yuki Kamifuku's final hometown show for December 10 in Fujisawa to bid farewell to her roots. TJPW also added a December 5 show in Itabashi, though the card remains to be determined due to roster members traveling to Texas.

stories.title: Kenoh Beats KENTA in Tokushima as Koga Ends Kitamiya’s Perfect N-1 Start
stories.tldr: Kenoh defeated KENTA with the Kenoh Special in the main event of Pro Wrestling NOAH's September 21 N-1 Victory show in Tokushima, bringing his B Block record to 2-2 while KENTA remained winless. In other tournament action, Koga handed Masa Kitamiya his first loss via backslide, Tetsuya Endo defeated Manabu Soya with a shooting star press, and OZAWA picked up a win over Titus Alexander. Outside of the N-1 matches, Alejandro pinned GHC Junior Heavyweight Champion Kai Fujimura in six-man action, setting the stage for their upcoming title match at Korakuen Hall.

stories.title: B&V: Mid-South Wrestling Nov 24, 1984, plus Granny and more!
stories.tldr: The Bryan and Vinny Show returns with a packed episode featuring Granny discussing her recent memoir reading and Q&A session at the old folks home.
