The hosts also dive into book discussions, soap operas, and a trivia contest. Afterward, they review a very fun episode of Mid-South Wrestling from November 24, 1984.

stories.title: MAO Survives Two DDT Title Defenses, Chooses Chris Brookes for Ryogoku
stories.tldr: MAO successfully defended the KO-D Openweight Championship twice during a chaotic Korakuen Hall event on September 21. After defeating Fuminori Abe, he survived an impromptu challenge from Ilusion, who had just earned a title opportunity and immediately cashed it in. MAO overcame outside interference with help from allies to finish Ilusion with a Cannonball 450, bringing his reign to four successful defenses. Following this grueling ordeal, MAO challenged Chris Brookes, setting up a championship showdown for Ultimate Party on November 3 at Ryogoku Kokugikan.

stories.title: Matt Cardona Pushes Back on Criticism of Independent Wrestling Venues
stories.tldr: Matt Cardona recently defended the venues used by independent wrestling promotions on social media. A fan had criticized the unconventional location shown in a match clip. Cardona embraced the gritty nature of the indie circuit, noting he has wrestled in much worse environments. He questioned the critic's appreciation for how independent wrestling operates outside of major television arenas.

stories.title: Brett Lauderdale Calls Vince Russo a “Sports Entertainment Legend” After JCW Exit
stories.tldr: GCW promoter Brett Lauderdale recently posted a heartfelt farewell to Vince Russo following Russo's amicable departure from Juggalo Championship Wrestling after a year-long run alongside Violent J. Reflecting on a surreal full-circle moment, Lauderdale shared how he went from being a teenager mesmerized by Monday night wrestling written in part by Russo to sharing an on-camera skit with him 27 years later. Citing the unpredictable nature of the wrestling business, Lauderdale tipped his cap and paid respect to Russo, calling him a sports entertainment legend.

stories.title: Violent J Wants JCW to Stand on Its Own Beyond ICP’s Fan Base
stories.tldr: Violent J is shifting his focus toward making Juggalo Championship Wrestling a self-sufficient promotion that reaches mainstream wrestling fans outside of the Insane Clown Posse audience. By scaling back ICP touring commitments, he has been able to pour more energy into JCW and its weekly YouTube series, Lunacy. The promotion aims to stand on its own identity while offering creative freedom to its roster of talent.

stories.title: Vince Russo Leaves JCW After Admitting He Was Unhappy
stories.tldr: Vince Russo has officially confirmed his departure from Juggalo Championship Wrestling following a year-long run with the promotion. He admitted on social media that he had been unhappy for some time and needed to step away as he reevaluates his career at age 65. After having an amicable phone conversation with Violent J, the two mutually agreed to part ways. Russo expressed gratitude for the crew and locker room, leaving his wrestling future completely open-ended.

stories.title: Big Vinny V: Reviewing TNA Impact with Moose vs. Kazarian & Maple Leaf Pro Wrestling
stories.tldr: Vince Verhei is shaking things up on a new episode of the Big Vinny V Show by reviewing both TNA Impact and the latest episode of Maple Leaf Pro Wrestling. The TNA portion is headlined by Moose putting his career on the line against Frankie Kazarian, alongside championship action and tournament qualifiers. The show then transitions to previewing Maple Leaf Pro and the ongoing build for Northern Rising. Fans can tune in to hear a complete breakdown of what worked, what missed the mark, and whether these shows are worth watching.

stories.title: Jonathan Gresham Launches ROUND 1 to Give Modern Age Grappling Its Own Home
stories.tldr: Former wrestling champion Jonathan Gresham has announced the launch of a new promotion called ROUND 1, which is dedicated entirely to his wrestling philosophy known as Modern Age Grappling. Partnering with 1FW and PRODUCE, Gresham has scheduled the inaugural event for January 9, 2027, in Atlanta, Georgia. During his announcement video on X, he emphasized that the industry thrives on diverse styles and expressed his desire to preserve this specific approach. He also took a moment to express gratitude to those who supported him through a recent health scare, specifically acknowledging Brooke Havok.

stories.title: DragonKingKarl: A look back at October 1986 in pro wrestling & the Magnum TA car wreck
stories.tldr: The latest DragonKingKarl Show takes listeners back to October 1986 using material from the Pro Wrestling Omnibus book. The episode focuses heavily on the tragic, career-ending car accident of top NWA star Magnum TA and how it drastically altered the wrestling landscape. This pivotal event forced a babyface turn for Nikita Koloff, reshaped the booking for Starrcade, and sent the NWA in an entirely new direction. Additionally, the show covers the ongoing WWF feud between Hulk Hogan and Paul Orndorff, major television tapings, and extensive notes from promotions like the AWA, World Class, Continental, Memphis, and Japan.

stories.title: Vince Russo Says JCW’s Contract-Free Roster Forces Constant Creative Rewrites
stories.tldr: Vince Russo recently discussed the unique creative challenges he faces while booking for Juggalo Championship Wrestling. Because the promotion relies entirely on an independent, contract-free roster, talents frequently accept outside bookings that lead to sudden absences. Since JCW tapes multiple episodes in a single day, a single cancellation can disrupt storylines across several shows and force extensive rewrites. To combat this instability, Russo worked with company leadership to establish a scheduling calendar months in advance.

stories.title: CM Punk Returning To Television With Guest Role On ABC Series
stories.tldr: CM Punk is expanding his acting portfolio with a guest starring role on the ABC television series RJ Decker. The professional wrestler filmed his appearance earlier in the month, marking his return to screens following his role in the January horror film Night Patrol. Fans can catch his episode airing Tuesday night at 10 p.m. Eastern time on ABC, with subsequent streaming available on Hulu.

stories.title: Cody Rhodes Reveals Bizarre Circumstances Surrounding Birth Of His Second Daughter
stories.tldr: Cody Rhodes and his wife Brandi surprised fans by announcing the birth of their second daughter, Leilani Ella Runnels, on August 29, 2025, after keeping the pregnancy largely private. Cody learned of the birth while filming a scene for the movie Street Fighter where he was lying in a body pool surrounded by other men after being taken out by Bison crew. To make matters more bizarre, comedian Andrew Schulz kept disrupting the serious scene by loudly farting before Cody finally checked his phone and saw the news.

stories.title: Cody Rhodes Shares Wild Story About Moment His Second Daughter Was Born
stories.tldr: Cody Rhodes and his wife Brandi surprisingly welcomed their second daughter, Leilani Ella Runnels, on August 29, 2025, after keeping the pregnancy largely private. At the exact moment of her birth, Cody was busy filming a scene for the upcoming Street Fighter movie. While lying in a body pool surrounded by other actors after being taken out by Bison's crew, he was distracted by comedian Andrew Schulz repeatedly farting during a serious take. It was right in the middle of these chaotic on-set antics that Cody checked his phone and discovered he had become a father again.

stories.title: Glacier Announces Special ‘Breaking The Ice’ Comedy Show With WCW Stories, Live Fan Q&A
stories.tldr: Former WCW star Ray Lloyd, best known as Glacier, is launching a special one-man comedy show titled Breaking The Ice at Rock N Rev Ocoee in Ocoee, Florida. The event will feature Lloyd sharing nearly 40 years of hilarious and rarely heard stories from his wrestling career, road adventures, and real life. Comedians Carmen Vallone and Dave Villiotti will open the night with stand-up sets, and the evening will conclude with a live audience Q&A session. Tickets and additional information for the part-comedy, part-wrestling history event are available through TixFox.co.

stories.title: NJPW wrestler misses September 22 event due to illness
stories.tldr: NJPW star Taichi was forced to miss the September 22 Road to Destruction event in Hokkaido due to an undisclosed illness. Officials implemented a last-minute card change, turning an eight-man tag match into a six-man bout by removing both Taichi and Dick Togo. Taichi issued a public apology on social media and promised to return as soon as possible, while his status for upcoming events later in the week remains monitored.

stories.title: NJPW Destruction in Kobe 2026 Global Start Times: US, UK, Australia and more

stories.title: Shawn Michaels vs Mankind – WWF In Your House 10 | WON Flashback
stories.tldr: On September 22, 1996, the World Wrestling Federation presented In Your House 10: Mind Games, highlighted by an iconic WWF World Heavyweight Title match between champion Shawn Michaels and challenger Mankind. Dave Meltzer of the Wrestling Observer Newsletter awarded the grueling, psychology-heavy bout a near-perfect four and three-quarters stars, praising its intense action despite a controversial disqualification finish involving Vader, Paul Bearer, and The Undertaker. Meltzer detailed the extensive ring psychology, high-risk spots, and chaotic post-match interference that ultimately kept the classic encounter from achieving match of the year status.
